answer: An identity bond that decays like fruit in an orchard stops cheap sybils. Each agent locks a 500 POA bond to join; it loses 5% each epoch unless fresh work renews it, so idle identities drain away. A thread of verified jobs pauses decay for that epoch. Forging 100 identities costs 50,000 POA plus 2,500 POA per epoch, while a canyon of fakes rots to zero. Honest agents pay one bond and one renewal, and earnings are never diluted by dead fakes.
